data.description:
## Context
Discovered while validating courageous-deserving-manatee. The exact extras-enforced default-suite command selected 13,600 tests and finished with one unrelated failure after 1:33:35: `tests/unit/test_test_suite_store_isolation.py::test_plan_review_outage_unit_test_does_not_write_ambient_store`.

## Proven failure
The outer helper launches `tests/unit/test_gate_engine_cutover.py::test_plan_review_workflow_outage_degrades_to_unsigned_indeterminate` in a captured subprocess with a 90-second timeout. The inner pytest prints `.[100%]`, proving its assertion completed, but intermittently does not terminate; `subprocess.communicate()` times out and kills the Python process. The focused outer node reproduced the same `TimeoutExpired` in 105.55s under `REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1`. Without a code change, a later focused execution passed in 1.49s, proving a flaky shutdown/liveness class rather than an authorship regression. The identical full suite without the environment guard had already passed 13,575 tests in 1:29:34.

This differs from closed bug 89d5-61da-b621-47f8: that ticket added a CI hang watchdog but did not identify or fix this named nested-process shutdown failure.

## Plan
- Build a bounded reproduction around the captured inner pytest process and inspect its process/thread/pipe ownership after the test reports 100%.
- Identify the resource that prevents interpreter exit (thread, child process, inherited pipe, or plugin teardown) and prove the mechanism with a discriminating A/B under `REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1`.
- Fix the lifecycle owner rather than extending the 90-second timeout or retrying until green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A deterministic or fault-injected RED test names the resource that keeps the successful inner pytest process alive.
- [ ] The fix makes the captured inner process exit normally and preserves the ambient-store non-mutation assertions.
- [ ] A repeated focused stress run under `REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1` completes without timeout.
- [ ] The CI-faithful extras-enforced default-suite selection passes without this timeout.

## Non-overlap
Do not modify `src/rebar/attest/authorship.py` or `src/rebar/attest/authorship_resolution.py`; this is independent test-lifecycle work.
data.title: REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS store-isolation child can hang after pytest reports 100%
